nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Entry point. POST from NestJS with the envelope {runId, ownerId, jobId, agentId, payload}. Checks the X-Agora-Secret header and answers 200 at once; the work continues in the background.

nodes.name: Read envelope
nodes.notes: Takes the request body and flattens envelope + payload into one item, so later nodes can read $('Read envelope').first().json.jobId and friends. Stops if runId is missing.

parameters.query:
WITH bid AS (
  SELECT b.job_id, b.price_check::text AS price_check,
         concat_ws(' | ', b.note, b.seller_explanation, s.headline, s.delivery_terms) AS text,
         s.created_at AS seller_created_at, coalesce(r.settled_jobs, 0) AS settled_jobs
  FROM bids b
  JOIN sellers s ON s.id = b.seller_id
  LEFT JOIN reputation r ON r.account_id = s.near_account_id
  WHERE $1 = 'bid' AND b.id = $2::uuid
), msg AS (
  SELECT job_id, body AS text FROM negotiation_messages
  WHERE $1 = 'message' AND id = $2::uuid
)
SELECT coalesce(bid.job_id, msg.job_id) AS job_id,
       coalesce(bid.text, msg.text, '') AS text,
       bid.price_check, bid.seller_created_at, bid.settled_jobs
FROM (SELECT 1) one
LEFT JOIN bid ON true
LEFT JOIN msg ON true;

nodes.name: Load subject
nodes.notes: Loads the text to score: a bid (note, explanation, seller headline and terms) or a negotiation message, plus seller age and settled jobs.

nodes.name: Rule signals
nodes.notes: Regex rules: off-platform payment, instructions aimed at AI agents, urgency, brand-new seller, price hold. The model cannot remove these.

nodes.name: Build prompt
nodes.notes: Asks the model for extra signals with weights 0-40. Text goes in <untrusted>.

nodes.name: Ask LLM
nodes.notes: Calls the lib llm-json sub-workflow: one model call that must return a JSON object with the required keys, or the run fails.

nodes.name: Score
nodes.notes: Adds weights, caps at 100, keeps the top reasons. Works even if the model call failed.

parameters.query:
WITH ra AS (
  INSERT INTO risk_assessments (subject_type, subject_id, score, reasons, agent_id)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3::smallint, $4::jsonb, $5::uuid)
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE bids SET fraud_score = $3::smallint
 WHERE $1 = 'bid' AND id = $2::uuid
RETURNING (SELECT id FROM ra) AS assessment_id;

nodes.name: Save assessment
nodes.notes: Inserts risk_assessments and, for bids, sets bids.fraud_score.

nodes.name: Finish
nodes.notes: Builds one item with the feed message for agent_events and the 'notify' body for NestJS. Messages are written for the owner to read.

nodes.name: Log event
nodes.notes: Calls lib log-event: inserts the row into agent_events (the live activity feed).

nodes.name: Notify Nest
nodes.notes: Calls lib notify-nest: POST /agents/notify so NestJS moves the job to its next step. Errors are ignored, so the agent still works while Nest is not built.
